verses.1: In that time, Herodes, the tetrarch, heard the voice of Jesus.
verses.2: And he said to his children, “This is John the Baptist. He rose from the dead, and because of this, the powers of evil do not operate upon him.”
verses.3: For Herodes had kept John captive. He also ordered that John be executed in prison, because Herodes had married Philip’s wife, his brother’s widow.
verses.4: For John said to him: “Do not have her with you.”
verses.5: And wanting to kill him, he was afraid of the crowd, because they regarded him as a prophet.
verses.6: But when Heroid’s daughter was born, she stood in the middle and begged Heroid to take her as his wife.
verses.7: He then, after taking an oath, promised to give her whatever she might request.
verses.8: And she was given to her mother for adoption. She said to me, “Give me John the Baptist’s head on a plate.”
verses.9: And the king, feeling sorry for them, ordered that they be given what was due to them according to their oaths and obligations.
verses.10: And when he sent John to prison, he forgot about him.
verses.11: And his head was placed on a table, and it was given to the priest. Then his mother was also mourned.
verses.12: And when his disciples came, they buried him and reported it to Jesus.
verses.13: And Jesus said that he would go there in a boat, to a deserted place of his own choosing. When the crowd heard this, they followed him on foot from all the cities.
verses.14: And when he went out, he saw a large crowd. He rushed towards them and healed those who were sick among them.
verses.15: After the vision occurred, the disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted; time has already passed.” He ordered the crowd to leave, so that they could go to the markets and find their own provisions.
verses.16: But Jesus said to them, “It is not necessary for you to go away. Give them something to eat instead.”
verses.17: But others say to him: “We don’t have five fruits and two kinds of fish.”
verses.18: And he said, “Bring them to me here.”
verses.19: And he ordered the crowd to stand on the ground. He took the five kinds of bread and the two kinds of fish, bowed towards the sky in reverence, and then handed the bread to his disciples. The disciples, in turn, handed them to the crowd.
verses.20: And they all ate it, and they were satisfied. In addition, they had to pay twelve copper coins for each of the classes.
verses.21: And those who ate were men, with a ratio of fifty to one compared to women and children.
verses.22: And he immediately forced the students to get on the ship and steer it towards the other side, until he got rid of all those people there.
verses.23: And after dismissing the crowd, he went up the mountain to speak to them in private. He was alone there when he arrived.
verses.24: The ship was already far away from the shore, several stadia away. It was being tossed around by the waves, as the wind was against it. After all, the wind was in the opposite direction to where the ship was supposed to be moving.
verses.25: On the fourth night, they came to them while they were walking along the sea.
verses.26: But when the disciples saw him sailing on the sea, they were afraid and said that it was a vision. They also cried out out of fear.
verses.27: But immediately, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Be not afraid! I am here to help you.”
verses.28: Then Peter replied to him, “Lord, if you really want me to go to those waters, then command me to do so.”
verses.29: And he said, “Come.” Then Peter got off the boat and stepped into the water. He went over to Jesus.
verses.30: But seeing that the wind was very strong, he became afraid. So, starting to punish himself, he cried out, “Lord, save me!”
verses.31: But immediately, Jesus stretched out his hand and took him by the hand. He said to him, “You ungrateful man! What have you done to deserve this?”
verses.32: And as they were getting on the ship, the wind stopped blowing.
verses.33: And those on the ship bowed down to him, saying, “You truly are a son of God.”
verses.34: And after crossing over, we arrived in Gennaresaret.
verses.35: And knowing that he was there, the men of that place sent him out into the entire surrounding area. They gathered all those who were in a bad situation and brought them to him.
verses.36: And they asked him to only cover the edge of his shirt with it. And those who did so were saved.
